title: BLE provisioning
description: Hands the device its WiFi credentials from a phone over BLE, instead of the setup access point. Credentials land in the wifi namespace; nothing here touches the radio.

keys.name: pop
keys.title: Proof of possession
keys.description: The passphrase a phone must present to provision this device. Generated at random on first use and kept, so it can be read once and reused; deliberately NOT derived from the MAC or the device id, because the advertised name already carries those. Clearing it makes the device pick a new one.
